PR: Attempt to tame E2E tests [closed]
### Description of your changes

Closes https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6546

In https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6405 I updated our E2E test runner, gotestsum, to attempt to re-run failed E2E tests up to 3 times. I did this because we had a few flaky tests, and were already in the habit of manually re-running entire test suites. gotestsum's re-run feature re-runs only the failed test, not the whole suite. It also does it automatically - so you don't lose time if you go do something else

and don't notice you need to re-run your failed test suite.

We also ran our E2E tests with `--fail-fast`. We recently learned that per https://github.com/gotestyourself/gotestsum/pull/448, re-run and fail fast don't work well together. What happens is, for example:

1. 5/20 tests run
2. Test 6/20 fails
3. Test 6/20 is re-run until it passes
4. If it passes, the remaining 14 tests never run
